grid_from_clause: with feicoes as (select (ST_SquareGrid(0.5, geom)).geom geom from ibge.pa_br_uf_ibge_2022 where sigla_uf = 'RR') select row_number() over () id, geom from feicoes
input_from_clause: create table split.input_split_ma as select row_number() over () id, 'CAR' id_layer, geom from car.car_18022025 c where uf = 'MA' union all select row_number() over () id, 'MUN' id_layer, geom from ibge.pa_br_municipios_ibge_2022 where sigla_uf = 'MA'
